messages.text: Q3 budgets are loaded in all networks per the *Q3 2026 UA Budget Plan* (Confluence). July daily total is about +4% vs June (~$53.8k/day). Split stays Meta 32 / Google 24 / AppLovin 21 / TikTok 14 / Unity 10; the 3% holdback is not loaded.
